name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: Watcher Backus has brought the search for Stormwind’s missing diplomat to Duskwood. A gathering of Defias bandits at Addle’s Stead may hold a lead.

sections.title: A Lead in the Gloom
sections.body: Watcher Backus of the Night Watch brings you to Duskwood. Several weeks ago, an unusually large gathering of Defias bandits came to Addle’s Stead. They usually keep to themselves across the border in Westfall, so their presence in the dark woods is a troubling change. Now you search the abandoned farmstead for the papers they left behind.

sections.title: The Defias Docket
sections.body: At the overrun farmstead, you find a locked footbox with a Defias Docket inside. The papers point to the brotherhood’s involvement. Yet Watcher Backus warns that the Defias may have forged them to mislead investigators.

faq.answer: Addle’s Stead lies in western Duskwood, just south of the main road from Westfall. Hostile Defias agents occupy the run-down farmhouse.
The Defias Docket is a collection of official-looking papers in a footbox at Addle’s Stead. It details some of the Brotherhood’s recent covert operations in the region.
Watcher Backus belongs to the Night Watch stationed in Duskwood. His town contacts and watch over border threats help him track unusual Defias movements along the Westfall border.

faq.q: Why are Defias operating inside Duskwood?
faq.answer: Defias operatives make quiet incursions into western Duskwood, though their stronghold lies across the border in Westfall. Addle’s Stead is an isolated waypoint away from Stormwind patrols.

faq.q: Can the contents of the Defias Docket be trusted?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus warns that the Defias may have planted false leads to throw investigators off their trail. The docket looks authentic, but its contents may mislead.

faq.q: Who originally pointed investigators toward Watcher Backus?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus says Elling Trias directed the investigation to the Night Watch in Duskwood. Trias is a cheese merchant and covert information broker in Stormwind.

angles.text: Stormwind’s missing emissary puts the kingdom’s security at risk. Defias intrigue reaches far beyond petty highway robbery in Westfall.
As a rogue, you must navigate criminal networks and judge genuine intelligence from Defias misdirection.
